title: Non-ASCII case conversion collapses the whole value to the first source
claim: CaseString/CaseBytes use exact ranges only for ASCII equal-length input; any non-ASCII byte yields one [0,len) range with the first source ID, attributing clean template bytes to user input and dropping later sources, although unicode case mapping is rune-for-rune and exactly mappable.
repro_command: GOTOOLCHAIN=go1.26.6 go test -count=1 -run TestReviewCase -v ./internal/taint/propagation/ (with .omo/review/evidence/prop-unicode/zz_review_unicode_test.go copied into internal/taint/propagation/)

title: strings.ToValidUTF8 is coarse although an exact segment mapper exists for bytes
claim: StringsToValidUTF8 publishes one whole-value range with the first source on any repair, while bytes.ToValidUTF8 maps copied/replacement segments exactly for the same data.

title: ToUpperSpecial/ToLowerSpecial/ToTitleSpecial/Title are not woven although README advertises case conversion
claim: Only ToLower/ToUpper/ToTitle have aspects; locale-aware *Special variants and Title in strings and bytes silently drop taint.
